heroHeadline: Board of Peace Won't Hold Israel to Ceasefire if Hamas Rejects Disarmament; IDF Controls 60% of Gaza; Outgoing IAF Chief Demands Independent October 7 Probe — Day 942
heroSubtitle: The deadliest attack on Jewish people since the Holocaust — assault timeline, hostage crisis resolved January 2026, intelligence failures, and IDF response. On May 6, 2026 (Day 942 / Ceasefire Day 209), the US-led Board of Peace made a decisive announcement: it will not hold Israel to October 2025 ceasefire terms if Hamas refuses to accept the disarmament framework — effectively giving Israel a diplomatic green light to resume full-scale military operations. Simultaneously, IDF forces have expanded control to approximately 60% of Gaza despite the ceasefire, with operational plans for war resumption reported as completed. On May 5 (Day 941), outgoing IAF Commander Major General Tomer Bar made a landmark public call for an independent external October 7 investigation at his handover ceremony to successor Major General Omer Tishler, stating it was 'vital for the IDF, for families who paid the highest price, and for trust between citizens and the military'; IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir acknowledged the air force 'failed in its mission.' Also on May 5, Hamas-Board of Peace disarmament negotiations entered complete deadlock, with Hamas demanding full Israeli withdrawal before any weapons talks while the IDF reported 19 ceasefire violations between April 21–May 5. Israel's Supreme Court July 1, 2026 deadline for the October 7 investigation framework — supported by 74% of Israelis including 68% of Netanyahu's base — drives escalating domestic accountability pressure. Cumulative Palestinian death toll since October 7, 2023 exceeds 72,600+; 830+ killed since the October 2025 ceasefire (2,400+ documented violations per Gaza GMO).
